name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe Toasted White Cheddar & Provolone Grilled Cheese (Skip Tomato Soup)
brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Made with naturally low-lactose aged white cheddar and provolone melted between toasted artisan sourdough slices—giving you a comforting Main Street classic once you skip the acidic tomato basil soup.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Toasted Cheese Sandwich and give the cup of Tomato Basil Soup to a family member (or swap for chips/plain bread), since concentrated cooked tomato + cream + garlic is a frequent flare trigger.
watchOuts: Skip dipping in the Tomato Basil Soup if nightshades or acidic tomato sauces trigger reflux or cramping
